newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain studying new overall law for gas/oil sector.
newsitem.headline: Spain studying new overall law for gas/oil sector.

text.p: Spain is studying a new overall law for the oil and gas sector that will also liberalise the gas industry, the Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Thursday.
"We have started work on a new bill on hydrocarbons that revises and substitutes for the current laws on hydrocarbons and gas," Pique told a news conference.
The EU directive on gas liberalisation stipulates an initial liberalisation for electricity generators and consumers of more than 25 million cubic metres.
"This would liberalise some 39 percent of the Spanish market," Pique said.
